title: rachel: quick note — onboarding citrine-mini int8 shows tokenization glitches when prompts mix Japanese/Chinese and a short Arabic parenthetical. reproducible on staging.
text:
rachel: quick note — onboarding citrine-mini int8 shows tokenization glitches when prompts mix Japanese/Chinese and a short Arabic parenthetical. reproducible on staging.

rachel: quick note — onboarding citrine-mini int8 shows tokenization glitches when prompts mix Japanese/Chinese and a short Arabic parenthetical. reproducible on staging.

takashi: can you paste a short repro prompt and one fp16 vs q8 example?

rachel: repro: "今日はいい天気。 翻译中文：今天是好天气。 (مرحبا)"

mei: fp16 -> "...今日はいい天気。 今天是好天气。 (مرحبا)"; q8 -> "...今日##はいい天気。 今天是好天气。 )مرحبا("

rachel: note the inserted '##' subtoken and bracket order flip in q8 sample.

takashi: any runtime warnings?

rachel: found "WARN runtime::kv_cache: pop index mismatch at step 58" in staging logs around that generation.

mei: tried disabling continuous batching; issue disappears in quick smoke.

eval-bot: scheduled targeted eval on multilang-mixset (100 samples) — job 2026-03-21_mix_12

ops-bot: temporary mitigation: disabled cont-batching for models tagged _int8 on route "multiscript-mixed".

takashi: next steps: dump kv state at boundary, kernel bisect for q8 backend variants, check detok reassembly logic. I'll pick this up.

rachel: opening triage with repro + kv dumps + eval diffs, will link here. :thumbsup:
